description.narrative: The program will strengthen the foundations for sustainable, resilient, and inclusive development in the Cook Islands. Amid the escalating risks presented by climate change and continued recovery from the impacts of the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic, the program will support the government's medium-term reform agenda to address sources of economic, fiscal, environmental, and social vulnerability. It will foster human development and private sector-driven growth by (i) strengthening the sustainability, resilience, and responsiveness of the public sector, including by rebuilding fiscal buffers supported by highly concessional financing under the program; (ii) supporting a healthy population and productive labor force; and (iii) laying the foundations for a sustainable and resilient natural environment.
